original_test_intent: Stress memory with the approved Intel PTAT mode-3 4500mb profile continuously for one hour and verify the host remains responsive with no new memory, RAS or system-log errors.
original_method: Verify licensed PTAT binary hash/version and platform support; confirm -mt 3 and -mtsize unit/scope from its help; inventory DIMM topology and available memory; mark logs; run the exact profile under a 60-minute external supervisor; monitor process liveness, allocation/utilization, temperatures, ECC/RAS/MCE/EDAC and BMC health; preserve full output and bounded post-log delta; stop/recover through OOB if thresholds or hangs occur.
manual_activity: Engineer approves PTAT package/profile and memory-health oracle; operator maintains cooling, power and OOB recovery.
safety_requirements: Use hard timeout and independent telemetry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal workload fits but lacks the one-hour supervisor and health oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `./ptat -mt 3 -mtsize 4500mb` under an external 60-minute timer while independently collecting memory/RAS/thermal telemetry and full logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Mode 3, 4500mb and one hour retained exactly pending semantic confirmation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use synchronized workload, OS/BMC telemetry and start/end log markers with a hard stop and post-stress memory-health check.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance, option semantics, numeric health stops, OOB and nondestructive log evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool completion alone cannot prove the system stayed healthy or that the intended memory amount was actually stressed for an hour.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: 4500mb may be per worker or total depending on tool revision; insufficient headroom may create OOM behavior unrelated to memory hardware.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines expected worker count/allocation, utilization floor, acceptable corrected ECC, temperature/power limits, response heartbeat and log patterns.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek uses the same source PTAT memory command; it is incomplete but not contradictory.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row437 Wistron-Memory-00018-V002: approve PTAT version/checksum/license/platform support, exact -mt 3 and -mtsize 4500mb semantics/worker scope, 60-minute timing, utilization floor, thermal/ECC/RAS/OOM/log thresholds, OOB abort and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes the one-hour memory stress measurable and distinguishes workload coverage from tool exit status.
independent_technical_reasoning: A zero exit does not prove one hour of meaningful memory pressure, and OOM or thermal throttling can leave the host responsive while invalidating the intended stress. Allocation and health telemetry must therefore be time-aligned with the PTAT run.
